verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a dashboard import tool that brings in an existing internet-accessible MySQL or MariaDB database with no downtime. A changelog entry adds attaching an existing MySQL database as an external keyspace. Community reports describe a smooth migration to PlanetScale Postgres, but one notes that moving off Heroku is harder because Heroku blocks logical replication. The documented path is limited to internet-accessible MySQL/MariaDB sources. missing for 10: a documented import/migration path for Postgres sources, details on cutover steps and downtime behavior beyond the headline claim, independent corroboration of zero-downtime MySQL imports.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an existing production database with minimal downtime using a documented migration path

citations.quote: PlanetScale provides an import tool in the dashboard that allows you to painlessly import an existing internet-accessible MySQL or MariaDB database with **no downtime**.
You can now attach an existing MySQL database as an external keyspace on a Vitess production branch.
